title: Pasta Carbonara
description: Creamy pasta with eggs, cheese and crispy bacon, ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water.
Fry the bacon until crispy.
Mix the eggs and parmesan in a bowl.
Drain the pasta, add the bacon, then stir in the egg mix off the heat.
Season with black pepper and serve.

title: Chickpea Curry
description: A cheap and filling vegetarian curry with coconut milk.
steps: Fry the chopped onion and garlic.
Add the curry powder and cook for one minute.
Add the chickpeas and coconut milk, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with rice.

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spicy tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Fry the onion and sliced pepper until soft.
Add the tomatoes and paprika, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Make four holes in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook until the whites are set. Serve with bread.

title: Chicken Wraps
description: Quick wraps with spiced chicken, salad and yogurt sauce.
steps: Slice the chicken and fry it with the cumin.
Chop the lettuce and tomato.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, salad and yogurt, then roll them.

title: Lentil Soup
description: A warm soup with red lentils and carrots for cold evenings.
steps: Fry the chopped onion and carrots.
Add the lentils, cumin and stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes, then blend until smooth.

title: Banana Pancakes
description: Soft pancakes with only three ingredients.
steps: Mash the banana and mix it with the eggs and flour.
Cook small pancakes in a hot pan, one minute per side.
